reasons: Quantity differs: postgresql.rows_deleted counts deleted rows, but the candidate uses postgresql.tup_fetched, which measures fetched tuples (reads).

Outcome is wrong: no fetched-tuples metric matches the deleted-rows quantity, so the correct result is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING unless a different OTel metric (for example a database row-operation counter filtered to delete operations) is verified to measure the same quantity.
Grouping maps correctly in principle (db to postgresql_database_name), but it cannot rescue a wrong underlying metric.
Unit differs: rows versus the '{tup_fetched}' unit of a different quantity.
